messages.subject: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
messages.subject_clean: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
messages.body_plain:
Good morning,

I've been through this several times but can't figure out the error. I've installed the package from the 'NicheMapR-master.zip' I downloaded from the Github site.

The problem comes when I run: library(NicheMapR)

It throws this error:

Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’

If I let R Studio fill in the parentheses then the name NicheMapR-master is an option but it throws the same error:

Error in library(`NicheMapR-master`) :
  there is no package called ‘NicheMapR-master’

I've tried removing the ' ' but no change...

I'm running R Studio with R 3.4.4

Thanks for the help. I'm very excited to analyze soil depth for my system!

Chris
